To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the presented computer-aided system for detection of ground glass nodules in lung CT scans is robust and accurate.
a two-stage classification system using a rich set of shape, intensity and context features is able to accurately detect GGNs in lung cancer screening CT scans.

a two-stage classification system using a linear discriminative classifier and a Gentleboost classifier can be successfully applied to the task of GGN detection in CT images, that shape features, intensity features and contextual features are all important for the classification of GGN candidates, that a rich set of 20 features can be extracted for each GGN candidate, and that our proposed system can be successfully applied on CT images obtained in a lung screening trial.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing a complete computer-aided system to detect and localize GGNs in CT images.
the design of a computer-aided system for the detection of ground glass nodules (GDNs) in thoracic CT scans, which are a specific type of pulmonary nodules.
the development and evaluation of computer-aided diagnosis systems for lung cancer screening and the detection of lung nodules.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the system presented is able to detect a high percentage of GGNs in a CT scan at a low false positive rate.
the proposed system is able to accurately detect ground glass opacities in lung CT scans with an excellent performance.
this system is the first one to show promising results on a large data set.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the system can accurately detect GGNs in CT scans.
the system is able to detect a large number of GGNs in thoracic CT images, and that it is able to do so at a very low number of false positives.
our system is the first to show that computer-aided GGN detection is possible.

the proposed system can accurately detect GGNs in CT images.
